experiments_or_tasks: Propose Self-Adaptive PINNs (SA-PINNs) with trainable pointwise weights that act as a soft multiplicative attention mask, trained to find a saddle point by minimizing losses and maximizing weights.

methods.name: SA-PINN
methods.protocol_description: SA-PINNs apply trainable weights on each training point, trained concurrently with network weights. The adaptation weights increase as corresponding losses increase, achieved by training to simultaneously minimize losses and maximize weights (saddle point problem). A continuous map of self-adaptive weights can be built using Gaussian Process regression to enable SGD. The NTK matrix for SA-PINNs is derived to analyze training dynamics.
